description: rn's checks on the session's record; each runs python3 only where it is found, and without it stops only in a repository with .rn/.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/posttooluse.py"; top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -d "$top/.rn" ] && { echo 'rn: its checks need python3 (3.9 or later); install it and run again' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stop.py"; top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -d "$top/.rn" ] && { echo 'rn: its checks need python3 (3.9 or later); install it and run again' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
